calibration: No fitted selector or threshold. Periods fixed before validation.
rule: Reuse residual/gate logits, current projection and recurrent value updated everywhere; new-view/age cells use gathered net; >=.8 unique halo support falls back dense.

source_training_contract.architecture: Pillar64 frozen; residual observation128 stride2; two downsample context stages192/256 with dilated residual blocks; single256 state; radius2 residual gated update with cellwise channel normalization; pointwise256 readout and trainable detection heads
source_training_contract.future_sparse: Radius2 update crop parity only, given full precomputed evidence; observation/context/readout remain dense; no active selector
source_training_contract.loss: Mean GT detection loss over labelled frames + .2 mean foreground head distillation over all frames in each TBPTT window; no teacher feature target
source_training_contract.protocol: Dense every-frame state update; memory_policy=recurrent; no augmentation/delay; same segment/gap resets and TBPTT windows as v1; no teacher state or periodic refresh
